decisions.reason: As a two-component glass flake spraying system that builds directly on our coating and spraying know-how, it fits our existing knowledge base and gives us a strong basis to refine it further through our own R&D rather than exit after only one year.

The low-pressure injection pump is very close to our established application equipment business, so our existing engineering, manufacturing, and customer-process knowledge make it commercially understandable and improvable.

A low-pressure material transfer pump extends capabilities we already master in conveying and process media handling, so our absorptive capacity for learning from early market use is high and supports continuation.

Fire protection flow monitoring builds on our installed-system expertise and aligns with our strategic move toward more digital and interoperable customer solutions, which our R&D and research links should help us develop further.
